messages:
jordan: PD alert fired — PD-87321 — synthetic check 'europe-heartbeat' failing repeatedly (5/5) in last 3m. Seeing a burst of 502s from the probe runner. tagging on-call. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created automatically: https://pagerduty.example/PD-87321 — urgency: high — check: synth/europe-heartbeat — first failure at 2026-03-15T23:12:47Z
pagerduty: Alert details -> service: synth-prober-worker-eu, event: http-502-burst, triggered_by: synth-runner-02, runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/synth-failures
maya: acked on PD — I'm jumping in, joining the bridge in 2m. Can someone paste the recent probe log?
jordan: quick logs below (last 3 lines):
```
[23:12:40] synth-runner-02 -> POST /probe -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream: inference-eu-03)
[23:12:41] synth-runner-02 -> POST /probe -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream: inference-eu-04)
[23:12:44] synth-runner-02 -> POST /probe -> 200 OK (control probe to stash)
```
charlie: do we have confirmed customer impact? Any 5xx spikes on public API or only synthetic harness?
jordan: dashboards show a small bump in 502s on /v1/generate in eu-west for hosted API customers between 23:11–23:14 UTC, ~0.9% of requests, errors correlate with the same upstream hosts the probe hits. Dedicated pools (reserved) show no errors.
alex: can we pause synthetic runs for eu region to stop noisy pages while we triage?
jordan: I've paused the scheduled canaries for eu-west (disabled in prober config). Also throttled prober fanout from 50 -> 5 to reduce noise.
incident-bot: Scheduled probes disabled: eu-west.* (user: jordan) — change-id: cfg-99821 — auto-ack window 15m
maya: I'm on the bridge, running a quick curl check against the inference layer.
```
curl -v https://inference.eu.redwood/api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer redacted" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
* Received HTTP/2 502
* Server: nginx/1.21
```
maya: confirmed a handful of 502s from inference-eu-03/04, looks like a transient upstream gateway error; suspect a routing flapping or kernel-level overload on those hosts.
support-ops: Pushing heads-up to Support slack and drafting a short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 502s for EU-hosted API customers; degradation window ~23:10–23:15 UTC. We'll update within 30m." Approve?
charlie: approve. call out that Dedicated customers unaffected.
jordan: mitigation steps executed so far:
- paused synthetic canaries for eu-west
- reduced prober fanout and throttled retry loops
- cycled network agent on inference-eu-03 (restart applied)
- opened PD incident and created infra ticket INF-6572
maya: running a targeted healthcheck script to collect backlog/KV metrics and CPU/IO on inference-eu-03/04. If we see sustained high iowait or accept queue growth, we'll isolate instance from loadbalancer.
alex: can someone add 'fallback to inference-eu-05' to smart-routing policy as temporary measure? I can apply a route override if we want quick mitigation.
jordan: applying temporary routing override now (route-override id: r-4420) to steer new traffic away from eu-03/04 to eu-05/06.
incident-bot: Route override applied: r-4420 -> target: inference-eu-05, inference-eu-06 — TTL 15m — applied by jordan
pagerduty: PD incident PD-87321 updated: responders: maya (primary), jordan (secondary) — status: acknowledged
maya: after override, error rate on /v1/generate dropped to baseline within 90s. Monitoring for 15m.
support-ops: customer note posted to support channel and queued for send after 15m if stable.
charlie: excellent. any root cause hypothesis?
jordan: preliminary hypothesis: short-lived gateway overload triggered by a combination of prober fanout spike + degraded upstream process on eu-03, causing nginx upstream failures. We'll keep investigating logs and kernel metrics.
maya: I'll continue with deep-dive on the instance (dmesg, network queues, conntrack). If we confirm kernel-level saturation, we'll schedule a kernel param tweak + restart during low traffic window.
bob: I'm next oncall in 20m — will take over if incident persists. please add any runbook notes to the PD incident before handoff.
jordan: adding notes to PD and INF ticket now. Handoff to bob at 23:35 UTC if all clear; otherwise maya will remain until stable.
maya: final update before short break — error rate normalized, route override will auto-revert in 15m. PD remains open for postmortem. I'll collect metrics for RCA.
jordan: thanks all — closing channel for active changes. Leaving PD open for post-incident follow-up. :thumbsup:
